predictions.articleTitle: Zorya Luhansk vs FC Kharkiv Prediction & Match Analysis: Break Rotation & Tactical Balance

Secondary Angle: Under 2.5 Total Goals supported by 60.9% Poisson probability below three goals and cautious 45-to-60-minute rotation blocks (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
